subject: Next steps: NovaHealth trial hosting proposal & owners / timeline
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Eric Yang <eric.yang@novahealth.ai>
Cc: Dr. Maya Patel <maya.patel@novahealth.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + proposed trial hosting options and asks

Eric — great to speak this morning. Quick recap of the discovery and a proposed path for the 4‑week technical trial so your team can evaluate latency, PHI handling, and integration effort. Please confirm preferences/constraints below so we can lock timelines.

High-level success criteria (from our call):
- Endpoints return responses within 300ms median at 8 qps for clinical note summarization (initial test set)
- No PHI leaves NovaHealth environment during inference; audit logs available for all requests
- Integration effort for the engineering team limited to a single POST call + header-based auth within 2 engineering days
- Quality: ROUGE-L baseline parity vs current ruleset on shared prompt set (Sofia will share prompts)

Recommended trial hosting options (pros/cons):
1) Hosted Redwood sandbox (fastest onboarding) — pros: no infra work, streaming enabled, cost-effective; cons: not ideal for PHI unless you use tokenization+redaction layer
2) Dedicated sandbox (isolated GPU pool) — pros: predictable performance, isolated tenancy; cons: ~48–72h provisioning lead time, requires an infra IP allowlist
3) VPC Private trial (recommended for PHI) — pros: data stays in your VPC, KMS integration, audit logs; cons: requires a short network config window, slightly longer setup (5–7 business days)

Questions / asks for NovaHealth:
- Which hosting option do you prefer (Hosted / Dedicated sandbox / VPC Private)?
- Who from engineering should we work with directly (name + email) to provision test credentials and any VPC peering?
- Are there specific compliance docs or IP allowlist ranges to include?

Proposed immediate next steps (if VPC selected):
- Day 0–2: sign trial MOP (attached draft) and confirm contact + IP ranges
- Day 3–6: Redwood creates customer VPC endpoint and shares test credentials; NovaHealth does network review
- Week 2: run baseline tests (latency/throughput) and one integration spike
- Week 3–4: quality evaluation and follow-up readout

Attachments: redwood-trial-checklist.pdf (checklist + required info), novahealth-mop-draft.xlsx (MOP template)

If helpful I can run a short internal kickoff with Ben (solutions) and Marissa (CS) tomorrow — suggested times on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/sofia-ivanova/30min

Thanks — looking forward to your preference so we can set owners and dates.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Eric Yang <eric.yang@novahealth.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dr. Maya Patel <maya.patel@novahealth.ai>, Procurement <procurement@novahealth.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed trial hosting options and asks

Thanks, Sofia — concise recap, appreciated. Short answers below: 

- Preference: VPC Private trial (PHI policy requires data residency inside our VPC; we need KMS integration).
- Eng contact: Javier Morales (javier.morales@novahealth.ai), senior backend; he can do the network review and provide IP ranges.
- Compliance docs: we need SOC 2 Type II and an outline of audit logging retention (30/90/365 day options). Procurement looped for contracts/PO.

Can you share a hardened list of required ports/IPs and an estimated calendar range (we'd like to start by Mar 29 if possible).

On timing — the 5–7 business day estimate works; if provisioning can be accelerated that would help. Let us know what you need from our side to move quickly.

—Eric
Director, Platform Engineering
Eric Yang
eraic.yang@novahealth.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-23T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: capacity & provisioning note for NovaHealth VPC trial

Looping in a quick operational note for routing/provisioning: 
- If NovaHealth wants VPC + KMS we should plan for a private deployment edge in us-west-2. Ops can provision a customer VPC endpoint in ~72h once we have IP ranges and KMS thumbprint. If they truly need 5–7 business days that's fine but we can often do it faster if everything is ready at kickoff.
- For the first pass, allocate a 1xA10G dedicated slot (dev-sandbox profile) — gives reliable latency at low cost. If they stress test beyond expected qps we can scale to 2x.
- Pre-reqs for NovaHealth: IP ranges, list of test prompts, KMS public key/thumbprint, an engineer point of contact for validation.

I'll be available to be on the kickoff call and to coordinate with infra. Marissa — please prepare a short test-priority checklist for the trial so we can verify success criteria quickly.

—Ben
Solutions Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Eric Yang <eric.yang@novahealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@novahealth.ai>, Javier Morales <javier.morales@novahealth.ai>
Date: 2027-03-25T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed plan & owners — NovaHealth VPC trial kickoff week of Mar 29

Thanks for the quick replies, Eric. Summary and confirmed owners below — planning kickoff for the week of Mar 29 with a goal to have test credentials in hand by Mar 31.

Confirmed hosting: VPC Private trial (NovaHealth requirement)
Owners / points of contact:
- Redwood provisioning & infra: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.ai) — provisioning of VPC endpoint, initial sizing, KMS handshake
- Redwood trial coordination & success criteria: Sofia Ivanova (sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai) — scheduling, prompts, quality buckets, readout
- Customer engineering lead: Javier Morales (javier.morales@novahealth.ai) — IP ranges, network validation, test creds acceptance
- Procurement / contracts: Procurement (procurement@novahealth.ai) — PO/contract signatures

Action items (owners + deadlines):
- NovaHealth: provide IP allowlist + KMS public key by EOD 2027-03-26 (owner: Javier)
- Redwood: finalize trial MOP (attached novahealth-mop-draft.xlsx) and return signed stub by 2027-03-27 (owner: Sofia + Legal)
- Marissa: deliver test-priority checklist and baseline prompt set by 2027-03-28 (owner: Marissa Cole)
- Ben: provision VPC endpoint once IPs/kms received; target creds by 2027-03-31 (owner: Ben)

Measurement plan during trial:
- Week 1 (provision + integration): connectivity checks, auth verification, simple POST/response smoke tests
- Week 2 (baseline perf): 10k sample tokens, measure median latency, throughput at 8 qps, and error rate
- Week 3 (quality): run provided prompt set, compare ROUGE-L and summarize differences; collect developer integration feedback
- Week 4 (readout & next steps): consolidate metrics + recommended production path (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Please confirm acceptance of owners & dates. If everything looks good I'll schedule a 30min kickoff on Mar 29 and include an agenda.

Attachments: redwood-trial-checklist.pdf, novahealth-mop-draft.xlsx
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/NH-2027-042

Thanks — Sofia
